channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: L.A. parent of Johnny Rockets, Fatburger and Round Table files for bankruptcy
item.description: Beverly Hills-based Fat Brands Inc. said in a statement that it filed for bankruptcy on Monday to restructure the debt it accumulated while expanding its company portfolio, citing 'difficult and largely unforeseen' market conditions.

item.title: 'New evidence' gives Jordan Chiles a chance to secure the return of her Olympic bronze medal
item.description: Switzerland's highest court has sent the case of Jordan Chiles' disputed bronze medal from the 2024 Paris Olympics back to the CAS based on 'new evidence' that might prove favorable for the U.S. gymnast.

item.title: Waymo under scrutiny after hitting child near Santa Monica elementary school
item.description: A Waymo driverless taxi in Santa Monica struck a child last week while traveling around six mph.

item.title: L.A. County to pause some payouts amid investigations into $4-billion sex abuse settlement
item.description: The county will pause payments from its $4-billion sex abuse settlement after the district attorney asked for a six-month delay while investigating fraud allegations.

item.title: Nicki Minaj, dreamer no more? After Trump event, rapper says citizenship paperwork being finalized
item.description: Did Nicki Minaj ever consider herself a DACA 'Dreamer'? The rapper said after an appearance with President Trump that her citizenship paperwork is being finalized.

item.title: Immigration raids pick up in L.A. as federal tactics shift. Arrests happen in 'as fast as 30 seconds'
item.description: Immigration enforcement tactics have fluctuated during the first nine months of the Trump administration's second term.

item.title: California Democrats help lead counter-offensive against Trump immigration crackdown
item.description: Democrats seized on a growing sense, shared by some Republicans, that the campaign has gotten so out of hand that the political winds have shifted heavily in their favor.

item.title: Senate Democrats and White House strike deal to avert shutdown, continue ICE debate
item.description: The deal could be approved by the Senate as early as Thursday night, but would still need House approval before midnight Friday to avert another government shutdown.

item.title: Santa Clarita girls hockey team members injured in fatal multi-vehicle crash in Colorado
item.description: Multiple members of a Santa Clarita girls hockey team were injured in Colorado after an out-of-control snow plow slammed into their sprinter van on Thursday, killing an adult traveling with the team and leaving one of the players in critical condition, authorities said.

item.title: Dr. Oz travels to L.A. seeking fraud. Newsom says his findings are ‘baseless and racist allegations’
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom called on the Department of Health and Human Services to investigate "Dr. Oz's baseless and racist allegations against Armenian Americans in California."
